honesty: Conserved condensatome overlap uses grape PlantLLPS tiers (atlas SQLite), soybean OrthoDB joins + deposited soybean tiers (data/second_crop/), and Arabidopsis OrthoDB accessions on grape rows. When arabidopsis_condensatome.sqlite is present, Ath Tier A/B is assigned with grape-trained PlantLLPS v13 (composition-proxy disorder; tiers recalibrated on Ath). OrthoDB eukaryote-level groups can be broad; curated cross_crop_hooks.json overlays are noted via cross_crop_family when present. Not a multi-species retrained model.
